title: 窃火，然后成为火
Steal Fire, Then Become Fire
description: 培养方向贯穿人与模型的共同实践。实践留下轨迹，轨迹进入反思，反思形成哲学方向以及对人、伙伴和关系的理解，再用于构建环境和作品。新的经验与相遇返回轨迹，继续修订理解。

A developmental aim runs through shared practice. Practice leaves a trajectory for reflection; reflection informs philosophical orientation and models of the person, counterpart, and relationship, which shape environments and works. New experience returns to the trajectory and revises understanding.
purpose: 参加窃火，用火培养自己
note: 新的经验，也会改变最初的培养方向。
New experience can also change the original developmental aim.

title: 参加窃火，用火培养自己
Join in stealing fire, and use it to cultivate yourself
description: 人在集体的探索与创造中参加窃火，与模型共同创造作品并遭遇世界的回应。参与可以培养理解、判断、表达和创造的能力，发展的能力又开启新的创造。作品和环境能够提供支持，但作品的积累并不等于人的发展。

People participate in collective fire-bringing, create with models, and encounter the world's responses through their works. Participation can cultivate understanding, judgment, expression, and creation; developing capacities enable further creation. Works and environments can support development without being equivalent to it.
note: 作品的积累，不等于人的发展。
Accumulated works are not the same as personal development.
